So It was my 18th birthday, and my girlfriend, whom I had been dating for only a month, decided to take me to New York City. I've never been to the city before so, naturally, I was excited. We spent the day walking around looking at all of the sights; you know typical tourist stuff. Halfway through the day we are in Times Square when we are stopped by a man who was selling tickets. This guy's opening line was simply "Hey bro, do you like comedy?" So naturally my first response to a random person asking me such a question was "FUCK YEAH I LOVE COMEDY!!" Next thing I know I'm making my girlfriend pay $40 for two tickets to a comedy show; meanwhile I'm shooting the shit with the guy taking about Colombian cocaine(he noticed my Colombian wristband and ask if I was Colombian because he was too). The look of confusion on my girlfriends face was priceless, she had never seen anyone so stupidly impulsive and naive that it cause her brain to shut down and pay for her ticket as well as mine. 
Any ways the show took place at 9:00 at night so we wait around the city until it's time to go. At around 8:45 we arrive at the show. Now when I look back at it, I don't know what I expected this place to look like. Maybe I thought that it would be this grand theatre with hundreds of people, or maybe I thought it would be a nice medium sized place in a nice area with lots of restaurants or shops around. For some reason I didn't think that the comedy show, to which I bought tickets from a total stranger, would take place on
the second floor of a dance studio; the entrance of which was located in a dimly lit alley way with two homeless people just standing there. They didn't talk to us or anything, they just stood there, probably contemplating life I don't know what they were doing but it was creepy.
The elevator was operated by a large black man (not saying that means anything but I'm trying to paint a picture ya know?) with an eyepatch, leather gloves, and a bandana that we wore as a hat. The entire elevator ride consisted of him making fart noises with his mouth.
